blocks.text: ⸺⁠But for heaven’s sake, let us not talk of quarts or gallons⁠⸺⁠let us take the story straight before us; it is so nice and intricate a one, it will scarce bear the transposition of a single tittle; and, somehow or other, you have got me thrust almost into the middle of it⁠—
—I beg we may take more care.
